a: A worldwide collection of connected computer networks
All the websites in the world
One huge computer owned by a tech company
tasks.fb: The internet is the network of networks. Websites are part of the World Wide Web, which runs on the internet.

tasks.q: What is the World Wide Web?
a: A collection of web pages that are accessed over the internet
tasks.fb: The web is one service that uses the internet. Email and online games are others.

a: Turns a domain name into an IP address
tasks.fb: DNS looks up the IP address for a domain name so your browser knows where to send its request.

tasks.q: Put the steps in order to show how a browser finds www.google.com.
steps: You type www.google.com into the browser
The browser asks a domain name server for the IP address
Domain name servers look up the name, asking other DNS servers if they need to
The IP address is sent back to the browser
The browser requests the page from the web server at that IP address
tasks.fb: You don't need the names of the servers for the exam, just the idea that DNS is many servers working together.

a: Storing websites or files on a server so they can be accessed over the internet
Inviting people to use your Wi-Fi
tasks.fb: A host provides the server space and connection that keep a website available.

tasks.q: Why might a business use a hosting company?
a: It doesn't need to buy, run and look after its own servers
Its website becomes invisible to competitors
It no longer needs a domain name
tasks.fb: The hosting company handles the hardware, power, cooling and connection.

tasks.q: Which is the best description of the cloud?
a: Storage and services on remote servers, reached over the internet
Files saved on a USB stick
tasks.fb: 'The cloud' is just other people's servers, in data centres, that you use over the internet.

tasks.q: Which is a disadvantage of using the cloud?
a: It relies on a stable internet connection
tasks.fb: No connection means no access. The other three are advantages.

tasks.q: In the relationship between a phone and a web server, what is the phone?
tasks.fb: The phone requests the page, so it is the client. The web server responds.

tasks.q: What does a web server do?
a: Stores web pages and sends them to clients that request them
Turns domain names into IP addresses
tasks.fb: Turning names into addresses is DNS's job; the web server delivers the pages.

tasks.q: Match each device to its role.
pairs: Stores files for users on a network

tasks.q: Which is an advantage of storing work on a file server?
a: You can open your work from any computer on the network
tasks.fb: Files stored centrally follow you to whichever networked computer you use.

tasks.q: Is each statement an advantage or a disadvantage of the cloud?
items: Speed depends on your network's bandwidth
Room for growth: easy to scale up
No hardware to buy: everything is hosted
Relies on a stable internet connection
Access your data anywhere, at any time

info.title: How many people?
info.text: Around two-thirds of the world's population now use the internet, and most of them connect through phones.
The address 8.8.8.8 actually belongs to Google's public DNS service. Some people set their devices to use it instead of their internet provider's DNS.

info.title: Cool servers
info.text: Data centres use a lot of electricity for cooling. Some are built in cold countries to cut cooling costs.

info.title: Someone else's computer
info.text: Your cloud files are stored on real servers in data centres, often copied to several locations so they survive a failure.

info.title: The web's birthday
info.text: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at CERN in Switzerland.

info.title: Root servers
info.text: At the top of DNS are root name servers. There are 13 root server addresses, but each one is copied to hundreds of servers around the world.
